steps.name: Exact D7 rule accounting and born-captured E07 witness
steps.description: Add the anonymous production counter, strict read-only netlink oracle, and lossless all-frame capture needed to prove the first eligible guest flow is born captured and protected without changing the public protocol.
criteria: The outbound rule inserts one anonymous counter after host-veth/TCP matches and before unchanged TPROXY, mark, and accept expressions; full normalized program identity is exact.
Strict multipart GETRULE and single GETGEN validate sender, sequence, family, framing, DONE, full nonzero generation, notifications, and reject every partial, malformed, loss, or mutation signal.
AF_PACKET/SOCK_DGRAM capture uses MSG_TRUNC with 65,535-byte L3 buffers, proves zero drops, rejects fragmentation/length ambiguity, and accounts exact checked packet and IPv4 tot_len deltas.
S-GTI-01/02/03/04/07 pass on qualified native metal; pre-cut capture sees every EtherType and zero guest frames, then the first eligible SYN has the exact tuple.
E07 runs through built serve/deploy/describe/job-stop, captures command/state/wire/kernel/cleanup evidence, and is independently reviewed without fixture identity or narrated evidence.
steps.implementation_notes: The observer is read-only and conservative. Normalize every ordered expression, register, operand, address, port, mark, and verdict; only counter values are placeholders. Require unique userdata tag, handle, and program. Strict framing checks kernel sender, sequence, type, family, length, alignment, DONE status, full nonzero NFTA_GEN_ID, and rejects DUMP_INTR, error, overrun, EOF, timeout, malformed, trailing, or partial input. Join the loss-detecting notification guard after production install but before GETGEN. AF_PACKET/SOCK_DGRAM uses MSG_TRUNC, a 65,535-byte L3 buffer, and zero PACKET_STATISTICS drops. Accept only kernel-valid unfragmented IPv4 TCP whose validated tot_len equals nft skb bytes. Stable quiet generation brackets and checked arithmetic require exact packet and byte delta equality, without wrap, reset, replacement, competing eligible traffic, or tuple ambiguity. Preserve existing public surfaces and existing TPROXY/mark/verdict behavior.
